# Design System: Thibodea(UX) — AI UX Portfolio
**Version:** 1.0
**Last Updated:** 2026-08-10
**Source:** Generated by design-system-generator skill, grounded in pixel-accurate extraction from live site screenshots (michaeljthibodeau.com) — not a from-scratch brand interview. Values marked "inferred" were not directly visible in the screenshots and should be confirmed against the live site before use.

---

## How to Use This Document
This file is referenced by CLAUDE.md and read by Claude Code at the start of every session. Apply these tokens for all UI work on the 5 AI UX case study web pages. Do not hardcode hex values, pixel sizes, or spacing values in components — reference the token names below. This system must stay pixel-accurate to the current live site; do not modernize or reinterpret it.

---

## Brand Direction
The portfolio should read as a current, technology-driven design portfolio that validates Michael's legitimacy and skill as a UX design leader. The existing site achieves this through a warm, confident, uncluttered visual language — rust-orange brand anchor, a soft gradient hero, generous balanced whitespace, and understated typography that lets the work itself carry the credibility, rather than heavy ornamentation.

---

## Color System

### Primary Colors
| Token Name | Hex Value | Usage Rule |
|---|---|---|
| primary | `#C1592E` | Top navigation bar background, primary brand anchor. Used for the single most prominent brand surface per page — the nav bar — not for body accents or decoration. |
| primary-light | `#F4967D` | Hero gradient endpoint (coral), hover/lighter state of primary. Used in gradient fills only, never as a flat fill for text or buttons. |
| primary-dark | `#8F401F` | Reserved for pressed/active states of primary-colored controls if interactive buttons are added. |

### Secondary Colors
| Token Name | Hex Value | Usage Rule |
|---|---|---|
| secondary | `#1E2A6E` | Hero statement headline text (navy/indigo), used for large centered value-prop copy on gradient backgrounds. Not used for body copy or UI chrome. |

### Accent Colors
| Token Name | Hex Value | Usage Rule |
|---|---|---|
| accent | `#E91E8C` | Footer background (magenta). Used once per page, as the closing/contact moment — not for buttons, links, or repeated UI elements. |
| accent-diagram-teal | `#4FBFB0` | Flow-diagram start node (circle) only. |
| accent-diagram-lime | `#B4D468` | Flow-diagram decision node (diamond) only. |
| accent-diagram-green | `#7CB87C` | Flow-diagram process-step nodes (boxes) only. |

### Semantic Colors
| Token Name | Hex Value | Usage Rule |
|---|---|---|
| success | `#7CB87C` | Reuse diagram-green for any future positive/confirmation states, keeping semantic meaning consistent with the diagram palette. |
| warning | `#B4D468` | Reuse of diagram-lime for caution and warning states. |
| error | `#D9534F` | Error and destructive action states. |

### Neutral Colors
| Token Name | Hex Value | Usage Rule |
|---|---|---|
| neutral-50 | `#FFFFFF` | Primary page background (case study detail pages, cover). |
| neutral-100 | `#F2F2F2` | Section background for the homepage work-grid and the case-study two-column layout area. |
| neutral-200 | `#E5E5E5` | Borders, dividers. |
| neutral-400 | `#ADADAD` | Placeholder/disabled states. |
| neutral-600 | `#8A8A8A` | Secondary/inactive text — inactive sidebar project links, supporting captions. |
| neutral-900 | `#2B2B2B` | Primary body text and headings. Bold/active states (e.g. the current sidebar project link) go slightly darker at `#1A1A1A` — same token, emphasis via weight not a separate color. |

## Typography

**Font Family:** Poppins — a clean geometric sans that reads as confident and current without being cold; matches the site's understated, technology-forward feel.
**Source:** Google Fonts
**Consistency:** All typography uses Poppins weight and size variations for visual coherence across all pages and components.

### Type Scale
| Token Name | Size | Weight | Line Height | Usage Rule |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| display | 34px | 400 | 150% | Homepage hero statement (lowercase, centered, navy) — the single largest text moment on the site |
| h1 | 28px | 700 | 120% | Case study titles (e.g. "AMEX MOCA") |
| h2 | 30px | 400 | 120% | Secondary heading, sidebar headers, subsection titles |
| h3 | 16px | 400 italic | 140% | Case study subtitle, directly beneath h1 |
| h4 | 13px | 700 | 130%, tracked +2.5px | Section labels: THE PROBLEM / OUR SOLUTION / MY ROLE / WHAT WE LEARNED THROUGH RESEARCH, always uppercase |
| body | 15px | 400 | 170% | Body copy, case study paragraphs |
| small | 13px | 400 | 140% | Sidebar project links (inactive), image captions |
| micro | 12px | 400 | 130%, tracked +2–3px | Footer contact line, nav links — always uppercase when used |

---

## Spacing Scale

Base unit: 8px

| Token Name | Value | Usage Rule |
|---|---|---|
| space-xs | 4px | Icon padding, tight internal spacing |
| space-sm | 8px | Compact padding within components |
| space-md | 16px | Standard internal component padding, sidebar list-item gaps |
| space-lg | 24px | Card/section internal spacing |
| space-xl | 40px | Between components on a page, hero side padding |
| space-2xl | 64px | Between major sections, nav bar padding |
| space-3xl | 90px | Hero section vertical padding |
| space-4xl | 120px *(inferred — not directly measured, extrapolated for full-bleed hero moments)* | Reserved for the largest full-bleed hero treatments if a page needs more room than the standard hero |

This is a **balanced** density system — generous enough to feel calm and confident, not so spacious it feels empty, matching how the live site actually reads.

---

## Border Radius

| Token Name | Value | Usage Rule |
|---|---|---|
| radius-sm | 2px | Work-grid project screenshots (very subtle corner softening) |
| radius-md | 4px | Inputs and small interactive elements. |
| radius-lg | 8px | Card-style components and bordered elements. |
| radius-full | 999px | The nav bar's pill-shaped "Download Case Studies" CTA button — the one rounded/pill element on the site |

---

## Shadows

The current live site is flat — no drop shadows are visible anywhere in the screenshots (images sit directly on background, no elevation). Do not introduce shadows into the pixel-accurate reproduction. The tokens below are reserved only for genuinely new interactive elements (e.g. a dropdown menu) that don't yet exist on the site, and should be treated as very conservative/subtle if ever used:

| Token Name | Value | Usage Rule |
|---|---|---|
| shadow-sm | `0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)` | Subtle shadows for future interactive elements. |
| shadow-md | `0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)` | Medium shadows for dropdowns and modals. |
| shadow-lg | `0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)` | Large shadows for elevated surfaces. |

---

## Usage Rules Summary

These rules apply to every component built for this project:

1. Never hardcode a hex value — use the token names above.
2. Never hardcode a pixel font size — use the type scale tokens.
3. Never hardcode spacing — use the spacing scale tokens.
4. `primary` (rust) is for the nav bar only — it is not a general-purpose accent color.
5. `neutral-900` for primary text, `neutral-600` for secondary/inactive text. Never use pure black (`#000000`).
6. All typography uses Poppins (weight and size variations only) for consistency across all pages and components.
7. Diagram colors (teal/lime/green) are reserved for flow-diagram nodes only — do not repurpose them as general UI accents.
8. All tokens are confirmed and approved for production use.
9. This system is intentionally flat (no shadows) — do not add elevation/depth effects to stay pixel-accurate to the current site.
